Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the target song tied to the February 17, 2017 country radio add date as “Seein’ Red” (which actually went to radio July 11, 2016) instead of “Small Town Boy.” This wrong anchor led the search down an incorrect path and subsequently to an incorrect album release date assumption (February 24, 2017) rather than the correct Current Mood release date of September 8, 2017. The Planner failed to pivot after evidence contradicted the initial hypothesis and did not cross-check authoritative sources for the correct single and album date.
